learningObjectives: Learning objective: determine how the coordinates of corresponding points change under specified rigid movements, and justify the pattern rather than memorizing one unqualified formula.
Reflection across x-axis: Mirror over horizontal line y=0.
Reflection across y-axis: Mirror over vertical line x=0.
